units.source_text: 小野篁诗云：“比良山上木绵白，足证神心已受容。”

en.t: Ono no Takamura's poem says, "The white paper-mulberry offerings on Mount Hira prove that the deity's heart has accepted them."

units.source_text: 但据藤原清辅的《袋草纸》中所载，此诗乃菅原时文所作。

en.t: But according to what Fujiwara no Kiyosuke records in The Fukurozoshi, this poem was composed by Sugawara no Tokifumi.
It is unclear which attribution is correct.
